title: Efficient Risk-Difference Estimation from Outcome-Dependent Validation and Stratified Label Audits

proof_attempt_summary: D-1.2 authored the fixed-parent audit-fused risk-difference package and reproduced finite-cell Fisher, gain, paired-oracle and drift diagnostics. D-0.5 rejected all headline novelty as incremental inherited machinery below the field floor; the next angle returned needs-pivot with no distinct surviving seed, and an independent validity gate confirmed novelty exhaustion. D0 solving and Lean formalization never began; continuum canonicality, uniform inference, LAN/lower bounds and the Zhou-Fu full-text priority comparison remain unproved or unverified.
tldr: Outcome-dependent internal gold validation permits correction of trial silver reports through classification ignorability. Independent true-label-stratified audits can estimate the same treatment-specific error channels without sampling causal outcome prevalence. The focal object is the exact audit-fused risk-difference variance, including covariance with retained internal pairs. The theorem package evaluates its source gradients, calibration gain and paired-record oracle, and gives a total histogram procedure with uniform first-order Wald inference on the prescribed one-dimensional Lipschitz parent. Generic shadow efficiency and constrained data-fusion projection are inherited. ASPIRE and mesbestim supply the prospective consumer; the iid benchmark does not replace the clustered trial analysis. Priority against the inaccessible Zhou--Fu article remains unresolved.
gap: Isenberg et al. identify the corrected risk difference and give classification-GEE inference. Graham--Carone--Rotnitzky already supply the general projection theory and an external binary-validation example. Neither inspected construction evaluates the retained internal MNAR-pair plus assigned-gold-label audit package with its exact allocation-correct precision and total full-class implementation.
fill: The proposed results instantiate inherited theory to the exact differential-channel experiment, evaluate its gain and oracle loss in observable primitives, and certify a data-only procedure uniformly over the unchanged compact parent. The genuine open task is an explicit primitive-uniform studentization error budget.
